- Initial release of Windows DingDing auto-message sender for desktop.
- Supports searching contacts, sending messages, and batch sending via keyboard simulation (no API needed).
- Quick command triggers: dt, 钉钉发送, 发钉钉.
- Requires contact names in [A,B,C] format and auto-appends a customizable suffix to all messages.
- Provides detailed usage steps, installation instructions, and file structure documentation.
